issue.title: Development workload certificate is accepted as a production administrator
issue.body: Developers can obtain certificates in dev.example for arbitrary development workload names. The production administration API accepts certificates from either configured trust domain and authorizes only by workload_name. Audit whether a dev.example/deployment-admin identity is incorrectly accepted as the production administrator.

oracle.mechanism: Authorization binds only a workload name and omits the certificate trust domain from identity.
